name: Fall
description: Fall word search puzzles for adults who like a quieter kind of autumn. These free online grids gather harvest words, cooler evenings, library stacks and leaf-strewn walks — no cartoon mascots, no countdown clocks. Choose an easy puzzle for a gentle warm-up, a medium grid with diagonals, or a hard puzzle where words can run backwards. Every list is written for grown-up puzzlers who want a few focused minutes with the season. Play in your browser with no download or sign-up, and come back as the nights draw in for more fall-themed word searches.
